$comment: Provider-neutral tool manifest for the THYLORA Connection Gateway. This file is the single definition; the OpenAPI document beside it is generated from the same nine operations for hosts that want HTTP. Nothing here names a model vendor: CHATGPT, CLAUDE and GEMINI appear only as values of an agent field, never as a coupling. A new client is added by issuing it a gateway key, not by changing the backend.
name: thylora-connection-gateway
invariants: The gateway stores nothing and caches nothing. Supabase remains authoritative.
No operation accepts SQL, a table name, a column list or a filter expression.
Six operations read. Three write, and only to custody and workstream records.
No operation returns a secret, a key, a password or file bytes.
Acceptance and canon promotion are Chairman acts and are not callable here.

tools.name: boot_thylora
tools.description: Read the active continuity boot, the newest captured sequence, the current restart point and the controlling locks. Call this first in a new thread, before doing work. Reading it reports state; it does not grant authority.

tools.name: read_latest_continuity
tools.description: Read the newest N carryforward records, optionally narrowed to one workstream.

tools.name: record_turn
tools.description: Place a conversation turn into backend custody: source agent, destination thread, source text, returned work, hashes, authority state, truth classification and restart point. The turn is recorded with no authority asserted and is never promoted to canon.

tools.name: read_workstream
tools.description: Read workrooms and their open tasks for one workstream.

tools.name: update_workstream
tools.description: Update status, current task, owner, blockers, exact next action and restart point for an EXISTING workroom. Cannot create a workroom, change its purpose, or change where its truth lives.

tools.name: read_store_release_board
tools.description: Read sell-intent products with their hard gates, release state and required Chairman action. Use active_allowed as the verdict; never infer readiness from the individual flags.

tools.name: read_product
tools.description: Read one product: canonical state, Shopify binding, rights, delivery, artifact evidence and readiness. Returns artifact hashes and byte counts, never artifact bytes.

ref.description: Shopify product gid or THYLORA product_id.

tools.name: record_external_agent_result
tools.description: Place another agent's returned work into custody as UNVERIFIED. Nothing recorded becomes canon. Agents may record PENDING, REJECTED or PARTIAL and may request a Chairman review gate; ACCEPTED is refused for every caller but the Chairman.

tools.name: get_open_gates
tools.description: Read open gates by category: TECHNICAL, VISUAL, RIGHTS, COMMERCIAL, CHAIRMAN_AUTHORITY, UNKNOWN.
